name: boiler_mean_specific_heat
title: Fuel-oil boiler modelled with the mean specific heat of the flue gases (cpbar)
summary: Fuel-oil heating boiler represented as a combustor (adiabatic flame temperature from the mean specific heat of the combustion products, routine cpbar of the ULiege combustion library) followed by a gas-to-water eps-NTU exchanger and an envelope-loss term; computes the boiler efficiency.

authors: Sylvain Quoilin (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, CoolSolve example)
Jean Lebrun (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES reference model)
Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES reference model)
origin.course: ULiege model bank, Heat Production by Combustion (reference model of 2008-01-10)

verification.reference: EES stored solution (62 variables, 42 with a counterpart) of the reference model TM-0492 (inputs of the stored run applied to this model); independent Python/CoolProp computation at the shipped inputs; stored solution of the CoolSolve example for the constant-cp variant (48/48)
verification.notes: 42 EES variables within 0.08 % (t_adiab 0.07 %, c_p_p 0.08 %, eta 0.02 %); independent CoolProp at the shipped inputs: T_p_ad 1974.46 vs 1974.48 C, c_p_p 1285.02 vs 1285.01 J/kg-K. Requires the CoolSolve fixes of branch fix/library-gaps (v0.3.0 fails with SingularJacobian) and the shipped .initials (default guesses do not converge).

related_external: thermo_models CLASSICAL_ONOFF_BOILER_SIMULATION_REFERENCE_EES_MODEL_SBJL080212.EES (TM-0492: EES original, reference model of the ULiege model bank; its stored solution is the verification reference)
